title: Implement vehicle rigid-body and AWD tire model
acceptance: the player car uses a dynamic Rapier chassis rigid body with a legally distributable placeholder GC8-era vehicle representation rather than kinematic translation
four wheel contacts drive spring/damper suspension and tire forces through scene queries with configurable wheelbase, track, ride height, spring, damper, mass, and inertia parameters
longitudinal drive/braking and lateral slip forces produce a progressive grip limit and the AWD drivetrain distributes torque through data-driven parameters
simulation uses a fixed physics timestep decoupled from render framerate and exposes enough telemetry to inspect wheel contact, suspension, speed, steering, and slip behavior
the car can accelerate, steer, brake, traverse uneven road geometry, and recover from ordinary contact without numerical instability in the Manhattan fixture
